source: Experiment-only shortest variant: the sentence is embedded in one question; answer true/false. Chat backends receive it as a single user message with no system message; native Decision models get the same question text with the state holding the sentence.

template.en: You are in quiet listening mode. The user said "{sentence}". Is the user asking you to wake up? Answer true or false.
template.zh-Hans: 你现在处于安静聆听模式，用户说“{sentence}”，请问用户是否要求唤醒你，回答 true/false

decision.en: You are in quiet listening mode. The user said latest_user_sentence. Is the user asking you to wake up?
decision.zh-Hans: 你现在处于安静聆听模式，用户说 latest_user_sentence 这句话，请问用户是否要求唤醒你？
